description: Wide event tracking the lifecycle of a scheduled (background, WorkManager-triggered) PIR run, covering scan progress in 10% increments, scan completion, and the follow-on opt-out scheduling phase. Sampled client-side at 20% (hardcoded in PirScanWideEventImpl.SCHEDULED_SCAN_SAMPLE_RATE) to keep pixel volume manageable.

name.description: The name of the application sending the event

version.description: The version of the app sending the event. Release builds are X.Y.Z; internal and nightly builds append the build number and channel suffix.

form_factor.description: The form factor of the current device

dev_mode.description: Whether the app is a debug build

platform.description: The platform the app is running on

type.description: The type of software sending the event

sample_rate.description: Sample rate for this event, between 0 and 1

is_first_daily_occurrence.description: Whether this is the first event completed with this feature name and status in the current UTC calendar day

name.description: The feature name for this event

status.description: The terminal status of the flow

execution_type.description: Always 'scheduled' for this event; included for parity with the manual wide event so dashboards can union the two streams.

profile_queries_count.description: Number of user profile queries used in the run

broker_count.description: Number of active brokers at the start of the run

total_scan_jobs.description: Total number of (broker x profile) scan jobs eligible for execution at the start of the run

web_view_count.description: Number of parallel WebView runners used during the scan portion. Equals min(total_scan_jobs, MAX_DETACHED_WEBVIEW_COUNT=20). 0 when there are no eligible scan jobs.

scheduling.description: How scan/opt-out steps were distributed across the WebView runners for this run, as resolved from the workQueueScheduling remote toggle at run start: a shared cost-ordered work queue (queue) or contiguous equal-count chunks per runner (static).

total_opt_out_jobs.description: Total number of opt-out jobs executed during the run. 0 when opt-out was skipped (no eligible form-opt-out brokers). Only populated on terminal events.

power_saving.description: Whether the device was in power saving mode at the start of the run

battery_optimizations.description: Whether battery optimizations were enabled for the app at the start of the run

vpn_connection_state.description: Reported VPN connection state at the start of the run

notifications_permission_granted.description: Whether the user had granted the POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime permission at the start of the run

tracker_blocking_state.description: Whether tracker blocking was enabled or disabled during the run

last_step.description: The last recorded step name when the flow terminated. Useful for understanding where flows drop off when status is FAILURE, CANCELLED, or UNKNOWN.

last_step_elapsed_ms_bucketed.description: Time from run start to when last_step was reached, bucketed using the lower bucket boundary. Recorded on every step after 'started'. On UNKNOWN/killed runs this is the only signal for how long the run had been going before termination, since the total_*_duration intervals are never recorded when a run is killed.

failure_reason.description: Reason a run failed. Only present on FAILURE events. Specific exception types are mapped to bounded values; anything not in the known set falls back to unknown_error. The phase the run was in when it failed is recoverable from last_step.

did_crash.description: Only present on renderer_gone failures. true = the WebView renderer actually crashed; false = the system reclaimed it (e.g. low memory).

cancellation_reason.description: Reason a PIR run was cancelled. Only present on CANCELLED events. superseded_by_profile_edit (a profile-edit re-scan replaced this run), superseded_by_new_run (any other newer run replaced it), profile_deleted/foreground_start_failed and the eligibility reasons (feature_disabled, subscription_expired, entitlement_lost, repository_unavailable) are client-attributed; work_stopped is a generic coroutine/WorkManager cancellation. The phase the run was in when it was cancelled is recoverable from last_step.

step.started.description: Parameter present when the run body actually begins (after the no-profiles early return)

step.progress_10.description: Parameter present when the rolling completed-scan-jobs count first crosses 10%

step.progress_20.description: Parameter present when the rolling completed-scan-jobs count first crosses 20%

step.progress_30.description: Parameter present when the rolling completed-scan-jobs count first crosses 30%

step.progress_40.description: Parameter present when the rolling completed-scan-jobs count first crosses 40%

step.progress_50.description: Parameter present when the rolling completed-scan-jobs count first crosses 50%

step.progress_60.description: Parameter present when the rolling completed-scan-jobs count first crosses 60%

step.progress_70.description: Parameter present when the rolling completed-scan-jobs count first crosses 70%

step.progress_80.description: Parameter present when the rolling completed-scan-jobs count first crosses 80%

step.progress_90.description: Parameter present when the rolling completed-scan-jobs count first crosses 90%

step.scan_completed.description: Parameter present when all scan jobs finish (signals the end of the scan portion; replaces a hypothetical progress_100)

step.opt_out_started.description: Parameter present when the opt-out scheduling phase begins (only when there is at least one eligible form-opt-out broker)

step.opt_out_completed.description: Parameter present when the opt-out scheduling phase finishes successfully

step.opt_out_skipped.description: Parameter present when the opt-out scheduling phase is skipped because there are no eligible form-opt-out brokers

decile_0_10_duration_ms_bucketed.description: Time from run start to crossing 10% of scan jobs, bucketed using the lower bucket boundary. A value of -1 means the device clock moved backwards during the interval, so the duration could not be measured

decile_10_20_duration_ms_bucketed.description: Time from crossing 10% to crossing 20% of scan jobs, bucketed using the lower bucket boundary. A value of -1 means the device clock moved backwards during the interval, so the duration could not be measured

decile_20_30_duration_ms_bucketed.description: Time from crossing 20% to crossing 30% of scan jobs, bucketed using the lower bucket boundary. A value of -1 means the device clock moved backwards during the interval, so the duration could not be measured

decile_30_40_duration_ms_bucketed.description: Time from crossing 30% to crossing 40% of scan jobs, bucketed using the lower bucket boundary. A value of -1 means the device clock moved backwards during the interval, so the duration could not be measured

decile_40_50_duration_ms_bucketed.description: Time from crossing 40% to crossing 50% of scan jobs, bucketed using the lower bucket boundary. A value of -1 means the device clock moved backwards during the interval, so the duration could not be measured

decile_50_60_duration_ms_bucketed.description: Time from crossing 50% to crossing 60% of scan jobs, bucketed using the lower bucket boundary. A value of -1 means the device clock moved backwards during the interval, so the duration could not be measured

decile_60_70_duration_ms_bucketed.description: Time from crossing 60% to crossing 70% of scan jobs, bucketed using the lower bucket boundary. A value of -1 means the device clock moved backwards during the interval, so the duration could not be measured

decile_70_80_duration_ms_bucketed.description: Time from crossing 70% to crossing 80% of scan jobs, bucketed using the lower bucket boundary. A value of -1 means the device clock moved backwards during the interval, so the duration could not be measured

decile_80_90_duration_ms_bucketed.description: Time from crossing 80% to crossing 90% of scan jobs, bucketed using the lower bucket boundary. A value of -1 means the device clock moved backwards during the interval, so the duration could not be measured

opt_out_duration_ms_bucketed.description: Time spent in the opt-out scheduling phase from opt_out_started to opt_out_completed, bucketed using the lower bucket boundary. A value of -1 means the device clock moved backwards during the interval, so the duration could not be measured

total_scan_duration_ms_bucketed.description: Time from run start to scan_completed — the full scan phase, including the final 90-100% band that the per-decile intervals don't cover — bucketed using the lower bucket boundary. Absent on runs that never reach scan_completed (e.g. UNKNOWN/killed runs). A value of -1 means the device clock moved backwards during the interval, so the duration could not be measured.

total_flow_duration_ms_bucketed.description: Time from run start to flow finish — end-to-end, including the opt-out scheduling phase — bucketed using the lower bucket boundary. Absent on runs finalized by the cleanup timeout (e.g. UNKNOWN/killed runs). A value of -1 means the device clock moved backwards during the interval, so the duration could not be measured.

name.description: Entry point the flow was started from
